goal.objective: Execute the corrected StegVerse heartbeat sampler once under the canonical WorkerCoordinator/runtime owner and persist inspectable oscillator-backed carrier observation proving that heartbeat progression depends only on the independent 10 ms phase oscillator.
success_predicates: Carrier runtime state persists nested oscillator.phase_travel_time_ms=10 and oscillator.snapshot_is_observation_only=true.
Carrier observation records observation_is_causal=false and authority_effect=NONE.
Heartbeat ordinal is sampled from elapsed oscillator quanta rather than incremented by invocation.
No GitHub token or NON-TV/TVC secret/token is required or forwarded.
StegVerse remains primary; third-party runtime is not required.
failure_predicates: Observed carrier state still uses GATE_PASSBAND_DERIVED as the progression rule.
Observed carrier state lacks canonical nested oscillator-only provenance.
WorkerCoordinator or a task state is made causal to heartbeat progression.
A NON-TV/TVC credential or GitHub token becomes runtime authority.
A third-party runtime becomes required or primary.
authority_ceiling: execute the canonical StegVerse heartbeat sampler

task.derivation_reason: Source correction is complete; the remaining required outcome is live sovereign execution evidence from the corrected sampler.

activation.recheck_trigger: next canonical WorkerCoordinator execution opportunity independent of heartbeat progression
activation.bootstrap_semantics: The first worker cycle materializes registry fragments into the canonical registry. The carrier cycle then samples the independent oscillator and carries non-authorizing assignment-trigger packets for unclaimed HANDOFF_READY tasks. The next worker cycle independently validates authority, binds a fresh claim/fence, and executes the live-proof worker. The heartbeat sample does not grant execution authority.

completion.next_authorized_action: Under the existing #122 StegVerse runtime owner, execute worker(1) -> carrier(1) -> worker(1). Verify canonical nested oscillator carrier/observation evidence, assignment trigger carriage, fresh fenced task binding, and COMPLETED / INDEPENDENT_HEARTBEAT_LIVE_PROOF_VERIFIED.
terminal_when: Carrier state contains frequency_rule=INDEPENDENT_OSCILLATOR_10MS_PHASE_TRAVEL and canonical nested oscillator invariants.
Carrier observation contains phase_travel_time_ms=10, observation_is_causal=false and authority_effect=NONE.
events/heartbeat-runtime.jsonl contains a non-authorizing worker_assignment_trigger_carried packet for this task.
WorkerCoordinator binds the task under a fresh fenced claim using the finite cost basis.
